[? cf S. lex. kolambaka] a large pot or vessel; Abh 456; Vin I 213,.18 (nave ca tile navaṃ ca madhuṃ ~ehi ca ghaṭehi ca ārāmaṃ āharāpetvā); III 250,.36 (~e pi ghaṭe pi pūretvā; Sp 710,.2 : ettha ~ā nāma mahāmukhā cāṭiyo vuccanti, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se koḷumbā); Ja I 33,.23 (~e khīrassa pūretvā uddhane āropetvā); Sv 58,.23 (ghaṭe udakaṃ ~e udakaṃ na pāpuṇāti, ~e udakaṃ cāṭiyaṃ udakaṃ na pāpuṇāti).
